text:
maya: Quick sync — vendors surfaced thermal derate guidance that could shift H100/H200 slotting and marketplace announce windows. They’re seeing sustained-power derates up to ~15% under rack PUE. How does this affect our SI dry-run timeline? @ops @legal :eyes:
tony: Which vendors reported that? H100/H200 only or also MI300/Gaudi?
ravi: MI300 reports are a mix — a few customers saw ~8-12% throughput drop on long seq workloads. Gaudi less affected so far.
maya: Summary from vendor calls: Nvidia H200 ~12% at 350W sustained, H100 occasional spikes, AMD MI300 ~10% in worst cases, Habana/Gaudi ~4-6%.
jenny: If press windows are tied to capacity, legal needs a 48h buffer for any slotting slip. We can’t announce then retract.
tony: Ops: can we map the derate -> tokens/s regression to our planned SKU allocations? If derate >10% we should reduce pending slots or enable burst fallback to B200 pools.
eli: We have telemetry mapping from perf-tests. Short snippet we use: ```thresholds = {"H200":0.88, "MI300":0.90, "Gaudi":0.95}``` that’s percent of expected throughput. We can run a sweep in staging and emit a CSV.
amos_nvidia: Nvidia update — stability team saw sustained derate ~12% in some configs. Microcode tweak coming next week that should recover ~6-8%. No ETA on rolling images to partners yet.
maya: @amos_nvidia thanks — can you confirm embargo window for public notes if adjustments are needed? We need to know whether to hold press or note "minor perf variance".
amos_nvidia: For now, hold public comms. We can provide a short partner note by EOD with numbers and expected fix window.
jenny: OK, we’ll plan for a soft hold + partner note. Ops to prepare fallback messaging for marketplace page (small banner).
tony: Actionable items: 1) Ops run staging perf sweep for H100/H200/MI300/Gaudi by EOD tomorrow. 2) Partnerships coordinate partner note draft w/ vendor. 3) Product to tag SKUs with derate-capacity flag. 4) Legal to sign off on messaging.
eli: I’ll kick the sweep now, ETA 6 hrs. Will upload CSV to the hw-capacity folder.
ravi: SI dry-run: recommend delaying the big canary for 48 hrs until we validate microcode patch impact. Smaller internal canary still ok.
maya: Noted. @deploy-bot can you schedule a canary image deploy to region-us-east-1 staging for H200 and MI300?
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy to staging-us-east-1 (canary) — image: hw-compat/v2.1. RunID: 202304_1815. Will post results to #eng-runtime. :white_check_mark:
jenny: Also FYI — marketing sync: we should not ticket any embargo exceptions without comms pre-approved.
amos_nvidia: Will send partner note draft to maya + jenny + legal by EOD.
maya: Thanks all, will reconvene after sweep results. If derate >10% and vendor fix ETA >72h we push announcement + notify channel two ways. :thumbsup:
